    LogFormatter.Builder
    LogFormatter.Builder.keyValue(String key, @Nullable String fallback)
    Creates a formatter that will print a single key's value, Logback/Log4j2 %X{key} style: just the raw value (or the fallback, or an empty string if neither is present) - no key prefix, no percent encoding.
    LogFormatter.Builder
    LogFormatter.Builder.keyValues()
    Adds all of the event's key values in the default key values format, percent encoded like a URI query: requestId=42&user=Ada%20Lovelace.
    LogFormatter.Builder
    LogFormatter.Builder.keyValues(Consumer<KeyValuesFormatterBuilder> consumer)
    Adds the event's key values as configured on a KeyValuesFormatterBuilder, which sets the format (percent encoding by default, JSON, JSON5, or logfmt), the keys, and the null handling, for example: 
    LogFormatter.builder()
	.keyValues(kv -> kv.format(KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format.LOGFMT).keys(List.of("requestId", "user")));
